canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date; symbol UTF-8 + NUL + date ASCII + NUL + big-endian IEEE-754 open/high/low/close doubles + signed 64-bit integer volume
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before execution; fingerprint recorded fresh at execution time

scope_decision: joint-paired block resampling: every resample draws one shared block-index sequence and applies it to both the overnight and intraday return components at once, preserving their real day-to-day pairing, and recomputes BOTH the Gap and Placebo statistics on that same resampled path; self-referential expanding-quantile event threshold (0.90, strictly positive), reusing _expanding_quantile unchanged, same convention as RSI's placebo, with the overnight component's undefined first observation excluded from threshold calibration via NaN-padding rather than the usual zero-padding; signed-continuation statistic (each event's forward return signed by that event's own gap direction), same idiom as Wave Pull, with a non-gating up/down diagnostic breakdown disclosed; placebo strips only the overnight precondition, applying the identical quantile rule to the intraday component instead, and is gated by a genuine paired-null significance test (p_gap_vs_placebo), not a bare point estimate; non-finite/non-positive price inputs rejected explicitly; pre-lock independent adversarial code review (three lenses, three agents) completed 2026-08-20, before the specification hash below was finalized, found and fixed six issues -- see the protocol's Pre-lock verification record

overnight_intraday_decomposition.definition: g(t) = ln(open(t)) - ln(close(t-1)) [overnight]; d(t) = ln(close(t)) - ln(open(t)) [intraday]; g(t) + d(t) equals the ordinary daily log return for t >= 1

event_and_placebo.definition: Gap(t) = 1{|g(t)| >= ExpandingQuantile_0.90(|g(1..t)|)}; Placebo(t) = 1{|d(t)| >= ExpandingQuantile_0.90(|d(1..t)|)}, self-referential (includes session t's own value), reusing backend/app/research.py:_expanding_quantile unchanged

signed_forward_return.definition: SFR(t) = sign(g(t)) * sum of log returns over the 10 sessions following the event close, for the Gap track; sign(d(t)) for the Placebo track

bootstrap.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with resampled_gap_mean_signed_forward_return >= observed, plus add-one correction

correction.family_definition: eligible assets, Gap event statistic only; Placebo compared per-asset, not a second Holm-corrected family

gates.placebo_rule: Gap mean signed forward return must exceed Placebo mean signed forward return on the same asset AND the paired-null p_gap_vs_placebo <= alpha
gates.reproducibility: byte-identical forward-return/p-value artifact on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

diagnostics.gap_direction_split: per-asset mean unsigned forward return and count for the up-gap and down-gap subsets of qualifying Gap occurrences, disclosed, non-gating

multiplicity.parameter_grid: none in this run; one locked quantile, cooldown, warm-up, and forward horizon

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope for this no-trade characterization run
scope_exclusions.no_book_level_or_executable_expression: any tradeable expression remains a separate, later, separately locked protocol
